about: A Git interface inside the Neovim editor, modeled on Magit.

prs.title: Discarding staged changes keeps your other edits
prs.broken: Discarding the staged part of a file also threw away edits that were not staged yet, so work was lost.
prs.changed: Only the staged changes are now undone, and the unstaged edits stay, the way Magit does it.
prs.matters: People can clean up what they staged without losing work in progress.
